rule.tail: record sau last_real (gio Vision volume>0 cuoi cung; neu Vision thieu record: close dung yen) -> BO
rule.head: record truoc first_real (volume=0) -> BO
rule.gap: run khong giao dich (volume=0 / close dung yen khi Vision thieu) >= 24h giua chuoi -> close=NaN
rule.short: run < 24h -> giu, chi danh dau mask

format: 14 B/rec big-endian [ts:int64 close-time ms][symId:int16][close:float32], sort (ts, ten symbol) nhu v1
mask_format: 11 B/rec big-endian [ts:int64][symId:int16][flag:uint8], chi record v1 co flag != 0

flags.1: tail stale (sau last_real) -> BO record trong v2
flags.2: run khong giao dich >=24h giua chuoi -> close=NaN trong v2
flags.8: record v1 khong co trong Vision hien tai (volume chua kiem duoc) -> GIU
flags.16: head stale (truoc first_real, volume=0) -> BO record
flags.32: stale suy ra chi tu close dung yen (Vision khong co record) — kem F_TAIL/F_GAP

r2_load_hourly.note: assert luoi 1h PASS; n_rows_bad = so record NaN bi loai

trend_rank_ic_load_closes.note: loader dang dai KHONG loc NaN -> NaN lan vao rolling (on, khong am tham)
